title: Unit Event — Our Happy Ending — Episode5 When You Were Here

meta.Event Outline: Following the successful 30th Anniversary Show, the Wonderlands×Showtime cast feel renewed determination for their respective dreams. Emu, realizing that the troupe will part ways sooner or later, attempts to put on a brave face and say goodbye with a smile. Meanwhile, Rui makes a bold proposition to the Otori brothers.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Then, let's go to the next city!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
I've got this line down!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And the next part's the final scene.
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “And they made shows together forever after”...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They made shows together... Forever after...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, it seems we're all on the same page!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I remember feeling so happy that time...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (My heart was full of joy and excitement about how we were going to put on lots and lots of shows together...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (And we really did put on a lot...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Our shows were so amazingly spectacular that I had a ton of fun just practicing them.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (And I wished that things would never change.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (If I don't stay strong, the others are gonna start to worry.)

rows.Speaker: Hinata's Voice
rows.Line: Emu, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
I'm sorry to bother you so suddenly.
I wanted to have some hot chocolate and ended up making a little too much. Would you like some as well, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait, but I just brushed my teeth!
Will it be okay if I brush them again after?!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I'd say that's fine.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, I'll have some!
Bottoms up!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe... It's so warm and sweet...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My chest is feeling all fuzzy wuzzy...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: You looked a little unhappy there for a second.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You're right...
I don't feel completely happy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Can we talk for a bit, Sis?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I see... And they'll be freelancing from here on out...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Are you sure about your decision, Emu...?
Don't you want to go with them?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because I'm never going to forget what we did.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Seeing all those shows with Grandpa...
A dozen or so years earlier

rows.Speaker: Little Emu
rows.Line:
Grr...
Grandpa, I can't see. It's too dark...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh. Just another second, dear.
Ah, excellent...!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
I'll remove your blindfold in...!
Three, two, one...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Hehe. This is nowhere in particular, but it can also be anywhere you like!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Ah, however... Today, it seems that it's going to be a magical forest. Take a look at the stage.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: Welcome to the Wonder Stage, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: Today's showing of “Teddy In The Magical Forest” will begin in ten minutes!

rows.Speaker: Little Emu
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
Lots of people just came in!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Ah, I should probably lower my head a bit to make sure the little ones can see.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Now, Emu, take another look at the stage.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: What you're about to experience is going to feel like a wonderful dream!

rows.Speaker: Teddy Bear
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
Why does everyone disappear whenever I try to go play in the forest? Are they afraid of how I look?”

rows.Speaker: Teddy Bear
rows.Line: “I know I seem scary, but I still want to become friends with them...”

rows.Speaker: Teddy Bear
rows.Line: “Oh where, oh where could all the forest critters have gone?”

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
Yes, they're over there!
Listen to my granddaughter!

rows.Speaker: Lala the Rabbit
rows.Line:
“I'm too afraid!
Us rabbits can't walk around the forest knowing that such a big, scary bear is lurking!”

rows.Speaker: Little Emu
rows.Line:
No, don't be afraid!
He's a nice bear!

rows.Speaker: Vivi the Squirrel
rows.Line: “Hey, what if that bear isn't as scary as we thought? He looks a little mean, but he could be nice.”

rows.Speaker: Little Emu
rows.Line:
He is!
He wants to be friends with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Vivi the Squirrel
rows.Line:
“Look...!
The bear's keeping that tree from falling! He prevented our homes from being crushed!”

rows.Speaker: Forest Animals
rows.Line:
“We gotta help him!
Let's go, everyone!”

rows.Speaker: Little Emu
rows.Line:
...!!!
Grandpa, Mr. Bear's about to make some new friends!

rows.Speaker: Little Emu
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Grandpa, are you crying? Why?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
How can I not cry?!
I'm just so happy that our bear finally has friends to play with!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Still, this is supposed to be a happy ending... As such, I should be smiling.

rows.Speaker: Little Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...♪
I didn't know shows were so much fun, Grandpa!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: This stage has the power to take you to a different world for every show.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: You could be in the jungle, on top of the clouds, in prehistoric times or even in outer space...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: It's a wonderland that can take you anywhere at all.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: If you ever want to smile, Emu, you should visit this stage. I guarantee that it'll take you somewhere fantastic.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: And once what you've seen here has made you smile, you should take a look at the world around you...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Unfortunately, unlike what you see on stage, it's not all full of smiles and happiness.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: But I'm sure what you witness will become the fuel that drives you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Grandpa was right...
The Wonder Stage made me smile so many times after that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And seeing everyone else smile there makes me really happy too...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I want to protect them both.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The Wonder Stage and Phoenix Wonderland that Grandpa left to us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's really sad that I won't be able to do shows with the others like I used to... But I'm okay with that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I think we'll be able to smile while we say goodbye to each other.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Even though they won't be members of the Wonder Stage cast anymore.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Even though we won't be doing shows together as much...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I should go brush my teeth...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I still need to do my best during practice tomorrow, so...! Night, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: She tried her best to compose herself, but she probably still is in her bed right now...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Do you have any ideas in mind...?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I know it's not right for us to intervene since this is between her and her troupe. But...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I want to see them smiling...
